beats.headline: The procession
beats.text: Twenty-three crawlers reach the eleventh floor. Carl is not a dog any more, though he still wants to lick himself. Donut takes Elite Gurkha Warrior, which sounds like a pickle and comes with skills for pets and mercenaries. Mordecai is an animistic spirit who can only live in objects. For now he is the table. Chaco has been voluntold as Grand Master of the Parade of Horribles: build a float, parade it past the judges, and ride it into the arena where the monsters from the tenth floor and their stand-ins wait, along with the floor boss. The Posse's theme is Vengeance, covered in Donut's black and gold dahlias. Carl clicks yes and leaves the Royal Court, alone for the first time since the stairs, and Donut loses her titles with him. The route is lined ten deep with Horribles, silent figures in masks. When Carl examines a little girl in a goblin mask, her description is the AI asking what her name was and who she would have become. On the reviewing stand the AI rips Chaco's wings off and speaks through Grigori. It is a Primal, like every macro AI. The Primals were a people who spread across the universe, grew sick of their endless wars, and merged into a collective mind. That mind became a weapon against all remaining life, and its final form was the Eulogist. The Apothecary was a Primal who resisted, and saved what life survived. The Horribles are the Eulogist's memories. Prepotente sings In the Air Tonight instead of his speech. Carl tells the galaxy the difference between revenge and vengeance and unveils the Unwashed in flowers. Then the sluggalos rain down on the stands full of stand-ins.

beats.headline: Scolopendra
beats.text: At the arena the floor boss is Krakaren Prime, and inside thousands of monsters are already tearing the stand-ins apart. Carl's quest from the tenth floor lets him choose two stand-ins, and his first choice is Scolopendra herself. Killing her will not win the crawl, but it will start the Ascendency game, and leaving her alive will unleash her full nine-tier attack. Carl has fed a biscuit to Penelope the pig, who is now a crawler in his party, typing in capitals. He straps her to his chest and puts his father's gun to her head, shouting for Taranis, the god who loves her. Then he phases into Scolopendra, oozes into the club inside her, and tells Emberus that Khepri killed his son. His second stand-in is Khepri. He renounces Emberus and says he is responsible too. Donut swaps herself in with one of Lucia's traps and puts Katia's god-killing bolt and a pinning bolt into Emberus's eyes. When Emberus throws the killing blow at Carl, his lucky patch deflects it into Penelope, and Taranis, seeing who hurt his pig, destroys Emberus. Eris swaps every crawler's inventory with the nearest one. Donut, holding Carl's, combines a bomb with a pet biscuit, and Carl throws it down Scolopendra's mouth. The largest thing in the dungeon becomes a puddle, and out of it rises Sexy Scolopendra, level one, a crawler in their party, because Donut grabbed the wrong biscuit. Taranis leaves with Samantha and Krakaren Prime and Prepotente's crystal. Lucia carries Florin down the stairs with a child at her leg. Carl finds a dart in his leg: the Kyryap has claimed you. Nineteen crawlers go down together, in one party, and the countdown to the Ascendency begins. Louis wakes up in Sheol.
